notes.title: Moncage review - a simply beautiful story-puzzler
notes.content:
On the face of it, the conceit that lies at the heart of Moncage isn't a particularly novel one. It's a puzzle game that's all about perspective, where changing your view or shifting your position can make the scene in front of you morph into something very different. It's about reframing - your opinions every bit as much as your view - until, with a little imagination and a touch of trial and error, you realise that you can take those shadows and stony dead-ends and turn them into something else. Something more hopeful.

It's a magical thing, really. Truly brilliant. That said, sometimes it feels like there's too much going on. Sometimes the scenes in front of you switch so unexpectedly - you'll know when it happens by a gentle audio cue and a golden glow from the window that's been updated - that you'll struggle to keep track of what's going on no matter how hard you keep on top of it. It's an on-the-nose metaphor for real life, I guess.

Other times, though, things seem unbearably dark. Bleak. You look for ways to improve it - perhaps force a little sunshine into your world - and that's a fitting enough analogy, too, especially when you find yourself too close to something to see the bigger picture, or too distant to examine the delicate detail. Or are you looking at everything through the distorted lens of alcohol, and maybe seeing things that aren't really there at all?

notes.title: Moncage is Set to Release on November 16, 2021
notes.content:
The development for Moncage began almost four years ago, and it has been such an incredible journey - particularly with the tremendous love and support from our amazing community. And today, we are extremely excited to announce that Moncage will be arriving on Steam, iOS, and Android on November 16th, 2021. You can pick up the game for just $13.49 on Steam during the launch sale, or $3.99 on mobile! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/6f394765b83180cc08082594c5c3c3ac136cc38d.jpg[/img]

Moncage is an award-winning vignette puzzle adventure inside a mysterious cube that connects parallel worlds through mind-boggling optical illusions. Each side of the cube houses a dynamic world with hidden connections to the others; the player must carefully manipulate the cube and find the possible connections and interactions between objects across multiple sides to decrypt the puzzles. 

Underneath the multidimensional puzzle-solving experience, there lies a delicate story about a young boy, his father, and a lighthouse. By interacting with objects across multiple scenes and from unique perspectives, combined with locating a hidden photo collection, you may just be able to uncover the secrets of the cube…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/b05c7ed652fc8e78cd49fb419acc5f216df14365.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/8483aa907a03fd17c668e76330a61b4bc8bd10df.gif[/img]

We have also made significant improvements and adjustments to Moncage over its early demo. In addition to the revamped visuals, we introduced an achievement system with 15 unlockable achievements, each corresponding with a Medal award; we also implemented an intuitive hint system to not only highlight key items, but to provide the player with thoughtful guidance via text and videos. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/f84dfa163a40f12ca4bf1ef694fdde2e61f3905c.gif[/img]

You can now wishlist Moncage on Steam. Don’t forget to also follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/XD_EN_Official]@XD_EN_Official[/url] and join our [url=https://discord.gg/CBMh4Y7w]Discord [/url]for the latest Moncage updates!

notes.title: Moncage 101: Introduction to the Hint Systems
notes.content:
In puzzle games, the act of putting seemingly disconnected pieces together to solve a particularly complex puzzle might be one of the most satisfying experiences there is; however, getting stuck on one maybe, well, the complete opposite of that, if not worse. 

If you, like us, have no resistance to a good puzzle game and also appreciate the occasional guidance to avoid getting stuck, then we have just the game for you. In [i]Moncage[/i], there are a multitude of thoughtful hints that the player can choose to activate for almost every situation. Regardless of your proficiency with puzzle-solving, this is a game that you won’t want to miss.

————————

[h2][b]Basic function: Focus[/b][/h2]

There are two modes in which a player can activate Focus - [b]Classic Mode[/b] and [b]Challenge Mode[/b].

In Classic Mode, activating Focus will reveal the key item that solves the next puzzle. This is recommended for most players.

In Challenge Mode, Focus will reveal all relevant puzzle pieces in the current scene. This is recommended for players who prefer a more challenging experience. 

As one of the basic functions in [i]Moncage[/i], Focus has been designed to help players effectively pinpoint their next move. At any point of the game, players can switch between Classic Mode and Challenge Mode as they see fit. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/27c9e0b35f3a8b9b627148ade619ea1defdd07c1.png[/img]
↑ Normal (without Focus)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/b3d0a0b3e7c76c67b271fc9e5947bca1ef879393.png[/img]
↑ Focus activated in Classic Mode can help players concentrate on the next puzzle

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/d9fc9a87b2aa6449535af6c448eeebab3dfe5287.png[/img]
↑ Focus activated Challenge Mode is recommended for patient players who prefer to figure out the puzzles on their own

————————

[h2][b]Hint system: hint text[/b][/h2]

In addition to Focus, there are hint texts.

Identifying a puzzle is only, well, the first piece of the puzzle; identifying that ultimate solution is the game changer. When the player is stuck on a particular puzzle for over a certain period of time, a question mark will pop up in the upper right corner - click on it to reveal the hint text. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/0ddaaacb0c523e2ad04048542bc99668737ade12.gif[/img]

Each puzzle in the game is equipped with 1 to 3 pieces of hint text. These hints are not meant to be straightforward spoilers, but to nudge you in the right direction and help narrow down on the possible solutions.

————————

[h2][b]Hint system: video walkthroughs[/b][/h2]

Even with the subtle hint text, it’s entirely possible that a player may still be struggling with the puzzles. This is where the video walkthroughs come in.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/13e6b223ca3f8026b4c8e36c4677fbbad684833b.gif[/img]

Although we want our players to thoroughly explore everything in game and find the solutions themselves, we understand that they may occasionally get stuck. So we implemented an ultimate safety plan - video walkthroughs. 

Once the player exhausts all hint texts for a particular puzzle but is still unable to solve it, they may opt to unlock a video that walks them through the exact steps to solve it.

————————

The development phase for [i]Moncage [/i]is almost complete and the game is scheduled to launch by the end of 2021. Wishlist us on Steam now to receive the latest updates about the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1195290/_Moncage/

notes.title: Everything to know about Moncage
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for following Moncage and for taking the time to read this. We couldn’t be more grateful for the remarkable support from our community thus far and have prepared the answers to some of the most commonly asked questions. We hope this will help give you a more clear understanding of Moncage :)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/3e10485789772f4ddeaed95dd0a84828efe89aa5.jpg[/img]

[h3]Q: What is Moncage?[/h3]
A: Moncage is an adventure puzzle game where the player explores a mysterious cube to uncover the hidden truth. By rotating the cube and seeing it from different perspectives, you connect the clues and objects across seemingly disconnected worlds to solve the puzzles. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/c294aa9121f1b173c373d321b02417eb8c887669.gif[/img]

[h3]Q: When will Moncage be available?[/h3]
A: Development for the game is practically complete at this point. We’re now adding some final touches to ensure a flawless launch of a 1.0. Official release is planned for 2021, so stay tuned! 

[h3]Q: Where can I purchase/download Moncage?[/h3]
A: At launch, Moncage will be available on Steam and mobile, followed by a release for Nintendo Switch. Wishlist us on Steam and follow us on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/XD_EN_Official]@XD_EN_Official[/url] to get the latest updates!

[h3]Q: The puzzles seem kinda difficult...[/h3]
A: Don’t you worry! We integrated thoughtful hints and prompts into the game -  if you ever find yourself stuck on a particular puzzle, try unlocking a hint that may help provide a whole new perspective and point you in the right direction to a solution. We’ll have a walkthrough for how this system works soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/1b26617a4ea2beff7abc944801ce91863a00be35.gif[/img]

[h3]Q: Is there a story to the game?[/h3]
A: Not only is there a story in Moncage, it is a critical part of the overall experience. Keep in mind that the progression of the story may be disguised as or triggered by specific settings, puzzles, and collectibles. Only by putting all the different pieces together can you uncover the full story.

[h3]Q: What was the motivation behind Moncage?[/h3]
A: We wanted to explore video games as a channel for artistic expression. Moncage was designed to be an experimental puzzle adventure where optical illusions and text-less storytelling seamlessly come together as one. Players are able to immerse themselves in a mysterious, multidimensional setting as they search for clues to gradually uncover the underlying story. 

Here are some early mockups and concept art:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/8d223b7dd5b18a91e6d0986e25d3c3cb9f1ae273.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/dbdf9ad0ff671961dafe6b3b8947451e4b9c6f4c.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/4fa1d9d178d60423e2ae3b7d0f07bdfdcf5e2234.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/b1e66d47e9b1d12a166f40a5db777db32786d66a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Q: How long have you been working on this game? What is your team like?[/h3]
A: We are a small team of two and have been working on this game for three years. We have been passionate gamers ourselves, and we both went to NYU for game design, after which we decided to pursue a full-time career in game design and development. With our focus for the game aligned around creativity, both of us were heavily involved in the creative process of the Moncage. We’ve learned a lot from this experience and are super excited for the future ahead of us as game developers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1195290/_Moncage/

notes.title: Moncage Set To Be Published Globally By X.D. Network
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[i]Moncage[/i] has gained a lot of love and attention since it was first announced. We’re flattered and super excited that so many of you not only see its potential. As far as game development is concerned, things are steadily progressing, and we’ll have a release date and price point soon (watch this space!). 

At the same time, we’re thrilled to announce that OPTILLUSION is cooperating with X.D. Network to bring this game to mobile, PC and Nintendo Switch, so that more players can experience the game across multiple platforms. notes.content:
It's time to enter Moncage's world，the demo version of Moncage has been published for download! 

This morning we noticed that some players could not download the demo. We have fixed this issue. Sorry for all the inconvenience bringing to you.

Hope you guys enjoys the game!
